blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.
blocks.zh: 使用工具的语音代理经常让用户在语音结束后等待,即使可操作信息在请求中提前到达. 光谱式方法在演讲期间开始工作,但块束式或中断式更新生成可以在一个工具调用完成之前截断. 这对夫妇计算发言更新的时间,限制了提前完成的有益工作. 我们引入了"心想"(Heartbeat Thinking),它通过新的"思想家"引用来处理更新的输入,同时允许正在进行的引用和发送的工具完成. 定期引用阅读最新的部分记录和关于已完成推理和工具结果的共同记录。 这些结果有助于解决缺失的论据并启动依赖性呼叫,从而能够在整个语音更新过程中进行准备以取得进展. 在整个SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG, Heartbeat改进了SHANKS式窗口基线的总投机工具覆盖或再利用,对最终任务质量有基准依赖效应。 在FDBench v3上,它将工具覆盖率提高了16个百分点,将平均最终反应延迟率降低了36.4%. 结果显示,心跳思维范式在语音中保留了正在进行的计算,可以将收听时间转化为可再使用的准备,以更快和更能进行语音代理响应.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Voice agents use external tools to retrieve information and carry out requests that depend on actions beyond the conversation itself. For these tasks, producing a useful answer requires both model computation and external execution, which can leave users waiting after they finish speaking. Conventional cascaded pipelines often place this preparation after speech ends. Yet the information needed to begin may arrive much earlier: an agent can identify an order while the user is still describing a delivery concern. Prior work has shown that reasoning and tool use can begin on partial speech, allowing some of this preparation to take place during listening ( Zhou et al., 2022 ; Chiang et al., 2026 ; Arora et al., 2026 ; Hooper et al., 2026 ) . The opportunity is to reduce how much work remains when the agent must answer the complete request.
blocks.zh: 语音代理使用外部工具来获取信息,并执行依赖于对话本身以外的行动的请求. 对于这些任务,生成一个有用的答案既需要模型计算,也需要外部执行,这可以让用户在完成演讲后等待. 常规级联输油管往往将这种准备置于演讲结束后。 然而,开始所需的信息可能要早得多:在用户仍在描述交付关切时,代理人可以识别订单。 先前的研究表明,推理和工具的使用可以从部分发言开始,允许在聆听过程中进行一些这种准备(周等人,2022年;蒋等人,2026年;阿罗拉等人,2026年;胡珀等人,2026年). 机会是减少代理人必须答复全部请求时仍有多少工作要做。

blocks.en: Early preparation is useful only when it produces work that can be reused for the full request. A tool call cannot be dispatched while its required arguments remain incomplete, even if the user has already provided enough information to construct them. SHANKS carries reasoning forward but bounds each generation episode by a speech chunk, which can truncate unfinished tool-call arguments ( Chiang et al., 2026 ) . SIA incorporates new events by interrupting ongoing generation; although dispatched tools are managed separately, a call may be interrupted before it is issued ( Hooper et al., 2026 ) . Frequent updates can therefore limit the uninterrupted time available to form a complete call. The evolving request determines whether completed results remain useful: an early search may need revision when the user adds a budget constraint. Stream RAG explores parallel retrieval and checks whether intermediate results can serve the final request ( Arora et al., 2026 ) . These considerations motivate a preparation policy that allows computation to finish across speech updates while letting later input determine which results still apply.
blocks.zh: 早期的准备工作只有在产生可重新用于充分请求的工作时才有用. 在需要的参数不完整的情况下无法发出工具呼叫,即使用户已经提供了足够信息来构建这些参数。 SHANKS将推理推向前进, SIA通过打断正在生成的工具,将新的事件纳入其中;虽然发送的工具是分开管理的,但在发出之前可能会中断呼叫(Hooper等人,2026年)。 因此,频繁更新可以限制不间断的可用时间,形成完整的呼叫. 不断发展的请求决定完成的结果是否仍然有用:当用户增加预算限制时,早期搜索可能需要修改. Stream RAG探索平行检索,并检查中间结果能否满足最后请求(Arora等人,2026年). 这些考虑激励了一项准备政策,允许计算完成语音更新,同时让以后的投入确定哪些结果仍然适用。

blocks.en: We therefore introduce Heartbeat Thinking , which handles new speech in subsequent invocations while allowing work already underway to finish (Figure 2 ). During listening, periodic Thinker invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. Independent invocations can overlap: one can finish constructing a tool call while another processes updated input. Requested tools execute asynchronously, and their returned results enter the shared record. Later invocations can use these results to resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls. Preparation can thus advance through successive reasoning and tool-use steps even when the transcript has not changed, without requiring each invocation to finish within an input-update window.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了“心动思维”(Heartbeat Thinking ),它处理以后引用的新演讲,同时允许已经完成的工作完成(图2)。 在监听期间, " 思想家 " 定期引用阅读最新的部分记录和一份已完成推理和工具结果的共享记录。 独立引用可以重叠:一个可以完成构建一个工具调用,另一个可以处理更新输入. 请求的工具同步执行,其返回的结果输入共享记录. 后来的引用可以使用这些结果来解决缺失的参数并启动依赖性调用. 因此,即使笔录没有改变,也可以通过连续推理和工具使用步骤推进准备工作,而不要求每次引用都要在一个输入更新窗口内完成.

blocks.en: To make this accumulated preparation useful for the final answer, Heartbeat separates speculative preparation from response generation. At the detected end of speech, a Responder receives the complete request and the completed preparation available at the handoff. It checks completed work against the full request, reuses applicable results, and performs the remaining calls. Unfinished speculative jobs are cancelled at this handoff, allowing the Responder to begin without waiting for their completion. This explicit exchange of reasoning records and tool results also allows the Thinker and Responder to use independently selected models.
blocks.zh: 为了让这种累积的准备对最终答案有用,Heartbeat将投机准备与响应生成区分开来. 在被检测到的语音末端,一个响应者收到完整的请求和完整的准备,可以在交接时得到. 它对照全部请求检查已完成的工作,重新使用适用的结果,并进行其余的呼叫。 未完成的投机性工作在此交接时被取消,让Responder开始而不等待完成. 这种对推理记录和工具结果的明确交换,也使智者与反弹者能够使用独立选择的模型.

blocks.en: Experiments on SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG show higher aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse than SHANKS-style Window Thinking. On FDBench v3, coverage increases from 34.67% to 50.67%, while mean final-response latency falls from 6.90 to 4.39 seconds (36.4%), also 45.7% below Pipecat, the fastest evaluated cascaded baseline. The coverage advantage persists across tested Responders. Task quality improves over Window Thinking on FDBench but decreases slightly on SpeechFCEval and AudioCRAG. Thus, computation spanning speech updates can increase reusable preparation and reduce final-response latency, while interpreting and using speculative results remains a separate challenge.
blocks.zh: 在SpeechFCEval,FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上的实验显示,与SHANKS风格的Window Thinking相比,总的投机工具覆盖度或检索再利用度更高. 在FDBench v3中,覆盖率从34.67%提高到50.67%,而平均最终反应延迟时间从6.90秒下降到4.39秒(36.4%),也比评估最快的级联基线Pipecat低45.7%。 在经过测试的救灾人员中,覆盖范围优势依然存在。 任务质量在FDBench上的Windows思维上有所改进,但在SpeechFCEval和AudioCRAG上则略有下降. 因此,跨越语音更新的计算可以增加可重复使用的准备,减少最后反应的延迟性,同时解释和使用投机性结果仍然是一个单独的挑战。

blocks.en: Early preparation spans prefix-based reasoning in LiveMind ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , response drafting in PredGen ( Li and Grover, 2025 ) , and maintained reasoning state in LTS-VoiceAgent ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . Figure 1 contrasts when reasoning and tool use occur in cascaded pipelines, SHANKS, and Heartbeat. Decoupled systems exchange preparation through completed tool results in SHANKS ( Chiang et al., 2026 ) , streamed outputs in DuplexOmni ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , or model-internal state in AsyncReasoning ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ) . Heartbeat connects independently scheduled invocations through completed reasoning records and tool results. Appendix F discusses these interfaces and streaming computation policies in more detail.

blocks.en: Heartbeat receives streaming ASR transcripts, dialogue history, and tool schemas. A periodic Thinker prepares reasoning and tool calls during listening; an endpoint-triggered Responder answers the complete request. The roles can use different models. Shared state stores completed reasoning records, requested calls, and their returned results. Figure 2 shows the architecture and execution timeline. Appendix A provides implementation details and the output schema.
blocks.zh: Heartbeat接收流传的ASR笔录,对话历史和工具计划. 一个周期性思考者在聆听时准备推理和工具呼叫;一个端点触发的Responder回答完整的请求. 角色可以使用不同的模型. 共享的国库完成了推理记录,要求的通话,以及他们返回的结果. 图2显示了结构和执行时间表。 附 录 A提供执行细节和产出计划。

blocks.en: Every Δ \Delta seconds, a new Thinker invocation reads the latest transcript and completed preparation. At most K K invocations run concurrently; a trigger is skipped when all slots are occupied. New speech and tool results enter subsequent invocations without interrupting ongoing generation. An invocation can take no action, return reasoning, or request tools with structured arguments. Completed reasoning is recorded before tools are dispatched asynchronously, so model and tool execution can overlap. Later invocations can use returned results to resolve missing arguments or initiate dependent calls, even without a new transcript update. The prompt directs the Thinker to avoid repeating pending or completed calls with identical names and arguments. Tool execution is queued separately from Thinker scheduling.
blocks.zh: 每个\Delta 秒,一个新的思考者引用 阅读最新的记录和完成准备。 最多 K K 引用会同时运行; 当所有插槽被占用时会跳过触发 。 新的演讲和工具结果进入以后的引用,而不会打断正在进行的一代。 援引不能采取任何行动、回溯推理或要求有结构化论据的工具。 在同时发送工具之前记录已完成的推理,因此模型和工具执行可以重叠. 以后的引用可以使用返回的结果来解决缺失的参数或启动依赖性呼叫,即使没有新的记录更新. 该提示指示思想家避免重复使用相同名称和论据的待决或已完成的呼叫. 工具执行与 Thinker 排程分开排队 。

blocks.en: At the detected end of speech, the scheduler stops new invocations and cancels unfinished Thinker and speculative tool tasks, including queued calls. The Responder receives the final transcript, history, schemas, and a snapshot of completed preparation available at context assembly. Later speculative outputs are discarded. Through a ReAct process ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , it checks preparation against the complete request, rejects interpretations contradicted by later speech, and reuses applicable completed results. Required calls lacking available results are executed within the Responder’s own process. It therefore begins without waiting for unfinished preparation. Appendix E.1 details the availability boundary; Appendices G.1 – G.3 give the prompts.
blocks.zh: 在被检测到的语音结尾,调度器停止了新的引用,并取消了未完成的思维器和投机工具任务,包括排队呼叫. 救援队收到最后记录、历史、计划以及上下文组装时提供的已完成准备的快照。 后来的投机性产出被抛弃. 通过ReAct程序(Yao等人,2023年),它对照完整的请求检查准备情况,拒绝与后来的言论相矛盾的解释,以及可适用的再利用完成结果。 缺乏可用结果的所需呼叫,在救灾人员自己的程序中执行。 因此,会议开始时没有等待未完成的准备工作。 附录E.1详细列出可用边界; 附录G.1 – G.3给出提示.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置和计量

blocks.en: We evaluate function calling on SpeechFCEval, intent following under disfluency on FDBench v3, and knowledge-grounded answering on AudioCRAG ( Tongyi Fun Team et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Arora et al., 2026 ) . Baselines are Speech-to-Speech, Pipecat, LiveKit ( Hugging Face, 2024 ; Daily, 2024 ; LiveKit, 2023 ) , and SHANKS-style Window Thinking. Window Thinking follows Heartbeat’s update schedule but discards outputs arriving after their windows. We use Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as Thinker, DeepSeek-V4-Flash (0731) as Responder, Δ = 500 \Delta=500 ms, and K = 2 K=2 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价SpeechFCEval的功能,在FDBench v3的不便下意图跟踪,以及AudioCRAG基于知识的回答(Tongyi Fun Team等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年;Arora等人,2026年)。 基线为Speak-to-Speech,Pipecat,LiveKit(Hugging Face,2024;Daily,2024;LiveKit,2023),以及SHANKS风格的窗口思维. 窗口思考遵循了 Heartbeat 的更新时间表, 但丢弃了在窗口之后到达的输出 。 我们使用Quen3.6-35B-A3B作为思维器,DeepSeek-V4-Flash(0731)作为Responder,QQ=500\Delta=500ms,K=2K=2.

blocks.en: Speculative tool coverage (STC) is the fraction of reference calls covered by completed matching speculative calls whose results enter the Responder context without the Responder repeating those calls. On AudioCRAG, it instead measures the fraction of samples reusing completed speculative results without additional retrieval. Task quality uses SpeechFCEval function-name/argument accuracy, FDBench Quality and Pass@1, and AudioCRAG correct-answer rate. Appendix B gives dataset sizes, matching and aggregation rules, and scoring protocols.
blocks.zh: 投机工具覆盖(STC)是已完成的匹配投机性电话所覆盖的参考呼叫的一小部分,其结果进入了Responder语境,而Responder没有重复这些呼叫. 在AudioCRAG上,它测量了在不进行额外检索的情况下重复使用已完成的投机结果的样本的一小部分。 任务质量使用SpeechFCEval函数名/参数精度,FDBench质量和Pass@1,以及AudioCRAG的正确回答率. 附 录 B给出数据集大小,匹配和汇总规则,以及评分协议.

On FDBench, Quality rises from 72.0% to 77.0% and Pass@1 from 57.0% to 65.0%, although Pass@1 remains below Speech-to-Speech and LiveKit. Heartbeat starts at − 4.37 -4.37 s versus − 2.74 -2.74 s for Window Thinking and 2.45–3.52 s for cascaded baselines. Heartbeat reduces it from Window Thinking’s 6.90 to 4.39 s (36.4%), also 45.7% below Pipecat, the fastest evaluated cascaded baseline. Appendix B.2 gives the protocol and numerical results.

blocks.en: Heartbeat retains higher STC across all three tested Responders (Tables 2 and 3 ; Appendix C.2 ). Later invocations can incorporate late constraints and explicit intent revisions before speech ends (Appendix D ). Yet 4.0% of FDBench recordings yield answers using erroneous or outdated results despite correct tool-call arguments, distinguishing call correctness from result use.
blocks.zh: Heartbeat在所有三个经测试的响应者中保留较高的STC(表2和表3;附录C.2)。 以后的援引可以包括迟到的限制和在发言结束前的明确意图修改(附录D)。 然而,4.0%的FDBench录音使用错误或过时的结果来给出答案,尽管有正确的工具调用论证,将调用正确性与结果使用区分开来.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Heartbeat Thinking overlaps speculative computation across speech updates and passes completed preparation to a separate Responder. Across three benchmarks, it retains more reusable preparation than a SHANKS-style windowed baseline; on FDBench, it also reduces final-response latency. Task-quality changes vary by benchmark, highlighting the importance of interpreting and using speculative results correctly.
blocks.zh: Heartbeat Thinking在语音更新中重复了投机性计算,并将已完成的准备通过单独的Responder. 在三个基准中,它保留了比SHANKS式窗口基线更多的可重复使用准备;在FDBench上,它也减少了最后反应的延迟。 任务质量变化因基准而异,突出了正确解释和使用投机结果的重要性。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Heartbeat uses a fixed scheduling interval and a bounded number of concurrent Thinker invocations. We have not explored adaptive scheduling based on changes in the partial transcript or the completion of tool calls. Such scheduling could reduce redundant inference when little new information is available. The Responder also receives a snapshot of completed preparation at context assembly, excluding tool results returned afterward. Future work could explore incremental delivery of late results, particularly for tools with variable execution times. Finally, our latency analysis focuses on FDBench v3, and further evaluation across different tool workloads would help characterize the trade-off between speculative coverage, inference cost, and response latency.
blocks.zh: Heartbeat使用固定的排程间隔和限定数量同时引用的思想家. 我们没有根据部分记录或工具呼叫的完成情况,探索适应性时间安排。 如果新资料不多,这种安排可减少重复推断。 Responder还收到了在上下文组装时完成准备的快照,不包括之后返回的工具结果. 今后的工作可以探索逐步交付滞后成果,特别是执行时间不定的工具。 最后,我们的潜伏性分析侧重于FDBench v3,对不同工具工作量的进一步评价将有助于确定投机覆盖、推论成本和反应潜伏之间的权衡。

blocks.en: Appendix A Detailed Framework
blocks.zh: 附录 详细框架

blocks.en: A.1 Task and framework overview
blocks.zh: A.1 任务和框架概览

blocks.en: Let x [ 0 , t ] x_{[0,t]} denote speech observed through time t t , H H the dialogue history including tool calls and results from previous turns, and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} the available tool schemas. The current utterance ends at T T . The task is to answer the complete request and execute its required tool calls using H H , 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and x [ 0 , T ] x_{[0,T]} . Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) provides partial transcripts during listening and a final transcript of the complete utterance.
blocks.zh: 让 x [0, t] x {{} 表示通过时间 t 观察的语句, H 表示对话历史,包括工具调用和以前转弯的结果, T\ mathcal{ T} 表示可用的工具计划 。 目前的说法结束于 T T. 任务是使用 HH, T\ mathcal{T} 和 x [0, T] x {% [0, T]} 来回答完整的请求并执行它所需要的工具调用 。 流式自动语音识别(ASR)提供监听过程中的部分笔录和完整语音的最后笔录.

blocks.en: Heartbeat separates preparation and response generation into two language-model roles (Figure 2 ). The Thinker is invoked periodically during listening to produce provisional reasoning and tool-call requests from partial transcripts. At the detected end of speech, speculative preparation stops and a separate Responder is triggered. It uses the final transcript and the preparation already available to complete the remaining reasoning, tool calls, and final answer.
blocks.zh: Heartbeat将准备和响应生成分离为两个语言模式角色(图2 ). 智囊团在监听期间经常被援引,以便从部分笔录中提出临时推理和工具调用请求。 在检测到的语音末端,投机性准备停止,并触发单独的Responder. 它利用最后记录和已有的准备来完成剩余的推理,工具呼叫,以及最后的答案.

blocks.en: Both roles receive H H and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and may use different models. A shared state stores current-turn preparation: completed Thinker outputs, their tool-call requests, and the associated results as they return. Tools execute asynchronously, independently of the model invocations.
blocks.zh: 两个角色都得到H和T\ mathcal{T},可能使用不同的模型. 共享状态存储当前回合准备:完成的思维器输出,其工具调用请求,以及返回时的相关结果. 工具执行同步,独立于模型引用.

blocks.en: A.2 Periodic asynchronous Thinker
blocks.zh: A.2 定期同步 思考者

blocks.en: Heartbeats occur at a fixed interval Δ \Delta during listening, with at most K K Thinker invocations running concurrently. A trigger is skipped rather than queued when K K invocations are already active. Otherwise, a new invocation starts without interrupting earlier ones.
blocks.zh: Heartbeats 发生在监听过程中的固定间隔QQ\Delta,最多K K Thinker 引用会同时运行. 当 KK 引用已激活时, 触发器被跳过而不是排队 。 否则,新的援引开始,而不会打断先前的援引。

blocks.en: An invocation started at t k t_{k} receives H H , 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , the latest partial transcript, completed outputs from earlier Thinker invocations in the current turn, and results from their tool calls available at t k t_{k} . New speech and newly returned tool results enter subsequent invocations rather than being injected into ongoing generation.
blocks.zh: 引用开始于 t k t_{k} 接收 H , T\ mathcal{ T}, 最新的部分语录, 先前 Thinker 引用的当前语录中完成的输出, 以及 T k t_{k 可用的工具调用结果 。 新的语音和新返回的工具结果进入以后的引用,而不是注入持续生成.

blocks.en: The Thinker can produce three forms of output: no additional action, reasoning only, or reasoning with tool requests. These are encoded as noop , think without tool calls, and think with tool calls, respectively. A noop indicates that the Thinker identifies no need for additional reasoning or tool requests given the current input and available preparation. Tool requests specify tool names and structured arguments once the necessary information is available. The prompt and output schema are given in Appendix G.1 .
blocks.zh: 思考者可以产生三种形式的输出:没有附加动作,只有推理,或者用工具请求推理. 这些被编码为Noop , 思考没有工具调用, 并分别用工具调用来思考. 一个Noop表示,根据当前输入和可用的准备,思考者确定不需要额外的推理或工具请求. 工具请求在获得必要信息后指定工具名称和结构化参数. 附录G.1给出了即时和输出计划。

blocks.en: Once a think output is complete, its reasoning record and any tool-call requests are written to the shared state, after which the requested tools are dispatched asynchronously. Since one invocation may request multiple calls, tool concurrency is controlled separately from Thinker concurrency: dispatch imposes no concurrency limit, while the execution backend queues calls for execution. A recorded call is pending until its result returns; the result is then linked to the request by its unique tool-call ID and stored alongside it.
blocks.zh: 一旦一个思维输出完成,其推理记录和任何工具调用请求都会被写入到共享状态,之后所请求的工具会被同步发送. 由于一次引用可能会请求多个调用,所以工具货币与Thinker货币被单独控制:发送没有施加货币限制,而执行后端的队列则要求执行. 有记录的呼叫等待到结果返回;然后用其独特的工具呼叫ID将结果与请求联系起来,并同时存储。

blocks.en: These records allow subsequent Thinker invocations to distinguish work already requested from results available for further reasoning. To avoid redundant calls, the prompt instructs each invocation not to repeat pending or completed calls with the same tool name and complete arguments. Returned results can also supply new information for dependent calls, allowing preparation to advance even when the partial transcript is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 这些记录允许以后 思想家援引来区分已经要求的工作和可供进一步推理的结果。 为避免冗余呼叫,即时指示每次引用时不要重复使用相同工具名称和完整参数的待发或已完成的呼叫. 返回的结果也可以为依赖电话提供新的信息,即使部分记录稿没有变化,也可以提前准备。

blocks.en: A.3 Endpoint-triggered Responder
blocks.zh: A.3 端点触发响应器

blocks.en: The voice activity detection (VAD) module triggers the transition to response generation at the detected end of speech. At this point, the scheduler stops launching new Thinker invocations and cancels unfinished Thinker and speculative tool tasks, including queued calls. The Responder receives the final transcript, the shared history H H , the tool schemas 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and the preparation available at this transition.
blocks.zh: 语音活动检测(VAD)模块触发了在语音检测端向响应生成的过渡. 此时,调度器停止启动新的思维器引用,并取消未完成的思维器和投机工具任务,包括排队呼叫. Responder收到最后的笔录,共享历史 H ,工具schemas T\mathcal{T},以及在此过渡时可用的准备.

The preparation snapshot is ℛ c = { r j : r j ​ is complete and ​ a j ≤ c } . \mathcal{R}_{c}=\{r_{j}:r_{j}\text{ is complete and }a_{j}\leq c\}. blocks.en: The Responder follows a ReAct process ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . It checks the preparation against the complete request and disregards interpretations contradicted by later speech. Its prompt directs it to reuse available results from completed calls that match the required operations in tool name and complete arguments. Required calls without available results, including those pending at the handoff, are issued by the Responder as part of its own ReAct process. Its system prompt and instructions for reading the Heartbeat context appear in Appendices G.2 and G.3 . The answer can then be passed to text-to-speech, and the dialogue and retained tool-call records and results are carried forward to subsequent turns.

blocks.en: For the main task-quality comparisons, the DeepSeek-V4-Flash Responder uses the 0731 version. The cascaded pipelines combine Qwen3-ASR with a text reasoning model. All experiments use NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

blocks.en: For SpeechFCEval and FDBench, STC measures the fraction of reference calls covered by completed speculative calls whose results enter the Responder context without repetition by the Responder. Reference matching follows benchmark-specific tool-name and argument rules; repetition requires identical tool names and complete arguments. SpeechFCEval averages per-sample coverage, whereas FDBench aggregates over reference calls and checks repetitions across each recording. AudioCRAG STC measures the fraction of samples reusing completed speculative results without additional retrieval. SpeechFCEval task accuracy requires correct function names and arguments and is averaged equally over its five task groups.

blocks.en: C.1 Task Results

blocks.en: Heartbeat achieves 43.69% STC, compared with 33.13% for the SHANKS-style Window Thinking baseline, an improvement of 10.56 percentage points. Across the five task groups reported in Table 6 , coverage increases in four, with Speech-BFCL parallel calling improving from 36.34% to 58.03%. SmartInteract is the exception, where coverage decreases slightly from 40.57% to 38.32%. Despite achieving higher coverage, Heartbeat reaches 66.85% overall function-calling accuracy, slightly below Window Thinking at 67.95%, although both outperform the cascaded baselines. This distinction indicates that retaining more speculative tool results does not necessarily improve function-calling accuracy.

blocks.en: Heartbeat achieves 50.67% STC, outperforming Window Thinking’s 34.67% by 16.00 percentage points. Unlike SpeechFCEval, its task-quality scores also improve: Table 7 records an increase in response quality from 72.0% to 77.0% and in Pass@1 from 57.0% to 65.0%. These results show that Heartbeat retains more speculative tool work while achieving better task success than the windowed baseline under spoken disfluency. However, its Pass@1 remains below those of Speech-to-Speech and LiveKit.
blocks.zh: 心跳达到50.67%的STC,比Window Thinking的34.67%高16.00个百分点。 与SpeechFCEval不同,它的任务质量分数也提高了: 表7显示,答复质量从72.0%增至77.0%,Pass@1从57.0%增至65.0%。 这些结果显示,Heartbeat保留了更多的投机工具工作,同时比在口语不顺畅情况下的窗口基线更能完成任务。 然而,其Pass@1仍低于Speak-to-Speech和LiveKit。

blocks.en: On AudioCRAG, Heartbeat reaches 62.42% STC but achieves a correct-answer rate of 55.49%. The cascaded baselines listed in Table 8 achieve correct-answer rates between 56.48% and 59.45%. Window Thinking achieves 20.05% STC and a 57.24% correct-answer rate. Heartbeat’s missing-answer rate increases from Window Thinking’s 14.33% to 16.84%. This contrast further illustrates that higher speculative retrieval reuse does not guarantee better answer quality. The benefit of early retrieval depends not only on retaining completed results but also on whether the Responder can use them correctly.

blocks.en: We group recordings by when the target entity and all constraints of the final request have been fully spoken. Early information arrives within the first 70% of the effective input interval; late information arrives within the final 30%. Effective input duration excludes leading and trailing silence. Explicit intent revisions form a separate group.
blocks.zh: 我们集体进行录音,直到目标实体和最后要求的所有限制都得到充分阐述。 早期信息到达的有效输入间隔时间的前70%;晚信息到达最后30%。 有效的投入期限排除了领先和落后的沉默。 明确意图的修订组成一个单独的小组。

blocks.en: For the early- and late-information groups, we measure the fraction of recordings in which a call with required arguments consistent with the final request is initiated before speech end. For the revision group, correction succeeds when an earlier call inconsistent with the final request is followed by a corrected call before speech end. These initiation-based measures differ from STC, which requires completed results to be included in the Responder context without response-stage repetition.
blocks.zh: 对于早期和晚期信息小组,我们测量在发言结束前发出与最后请求相一致的电话录音的一小部分。 对修订小组而言,如果先前的电话与最后请求不一致,在发言结束前再发出更正的电话,更正即告成功。 这些基于启动的措施与STC不同,STC要求将完成的结果纳入Responder语境而不重复反应阶段.

blocks.en: In these failures, a correct-argument tool request coexists with a final answer that uses erroneous or outdated speculative results.

blocks.en: For example, the system adds a $99.99 coffee maker to the cart before hearing the complete $50 budget, then retrieves a $40 product. The answer claims that the cheaper product was added but reports the earlier $99.99 cart total, mixing the two results. The corrected search does not undo the cart action.

blocks.en: E.1 Overlapping jobs and the response boundary
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 重叠任务和响应边界

blocks.en: A tool call dispatched during listening contributes its result to the initial Responder context when the result is complete and available at context assembly c c (Equation 1 ). At the detected end of speech, the scheduler stops launching new Thinker invocations and cancels unfinished Thinker and speculative tool tasks, including queued calls. Later results are excluded from the current response.
blocks.zh: 一个在监听过程中发出的工具调用,当结果完成并在上下文组装c(方程式1 )中可用时,会将其结果贡献给初始的Responder上下文. 在检测到的演讲结尾,调度器停止启动新的 Thinker 引用,并取消未完成的 Thinker 和投机工具任务,包括排队呼叫. 其后的结果被排除在目前的反应之外。

blocks.en: At context assembly, a completed Thinker record may be available even if its requested tool result is unavailable. Overlapping invocations can finish out of order.
blocks.zh: 在上下文组装时,即使没有所要求的工具结果,也可以提供已完成的思维者记录。 重叠引用可以完成有序.

blocks.en: E.2 Interpreting speculative tool coverage
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 解释投机工具覆盖范围

blocks.en: Each reference call contributes at most once to a request’s coverage fraction. The denominator is the number of reference calls; repeated speculative attempts cannot contribute multiple matches to the same reference call. Matching a reference and detecting a Responder repetition are separate tests. The first establishes relevance under the benchmark’s matching rule, while the second removes retained coverage when the Responder makes a call with the same tool name and exactly the same arguments.
blocks.zh: 每个参考电话最多一次有助于请求的覆盖范围。 分母是参考调用的次数;重复的投机尝试不能为同一参考调用提供多种匹配. 匹配一个引用并检测一个响应重复是单独的测试. 第一种是在基准的匹配规则下确定关联性的,第二种则在Responder使用相同的工具名称和完全相同的参数进行呼叫时删除了保留覆盖.

blocks.en: Suppose a request requires two calls. Both speculative results are completed and injected, but the Responder repeats one with identical arguments. The request’s non-repeated coverage is 1 / 2 1/2 . If one result instead arrives after context assembly and the other is not repeated, the coverage is also 1 / 2 1/2 , but the loss now occurs at the preparation boundary rather than through response-time repetition.
blocks.zh: 如果一个请求需要两个电话。 两种推测结果都完成并注入,但responder重复一个,有相同的论点. 请求中未重复的涵盖范围为1/2. 如果一种结果在上下文组装之后才到达,而另一种结果不重复,则覆盖范围也是1/2 1/2,但损失现在发生在准备边界,而不是通过反应时间重复。

blocks.en: Appendix F Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 有关工作

blocks.en:
Preparation from partial input can target intermediate reasoning, candidate responses, or both.
LiveMind stores prefix-based inferences in memory for subsequent reasoning and final response generation ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
PredGen instead drafts candidate responses, verifies reusable prefixes as input grows, and prepares audio for the first sentence ( Li and Grover, 2025 ) .
LTS-VoiceAgent combines these forms of preparation: its Thinker maintains corrected transcripts, key variables, and plans, while its Speaker uses this state to begin solving and generating responses before speech ends ( Zou et al., 2026 ) .
The prepared content therefore ranges from reasoning context for later generation to response text and audio that can be reused directly.
blocks.zh:
部分投入的准备可以针对中间推理,候选反应,或者两者兼而有之.
LiveMind存储基于前缀的推论,用于后续推理和最终反应生成(Chen等人,2024年).
PredGen代之以起草候选响应,在输入增加时验证可重复使用的前缀,并为第一句准备音频(Li and Grover, 2025).
LTS-VoiceAgent结合了这些形式的准备:其思想家维护经更正的文字记录、关键变量和计划,而其研究者则维护了这些格式。 演说者利用这个状态在演讲结束前开始解答和生成回应(Zou等人,2026年).
因此,所编制的内容从下一代的推理背景到可直接重复使用的响应文本和音频不等。

blocks.en:
Early tool execution was studied in online semantic parsing through prefix-to-program prediction and selective subprogram execution ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) .
Subsequent systems differ in how computation proceeds as input changes.
SHANKS interleaves speech chunks with reasoning and tool calls, but its per-chunk generation budget can leave long call arguments incomplete ( Chiang et al., 2026 , Appendix C.2) .
Stream RAG contrasts fixed-interval parallel retrieval with model-triggered queries that terminate unfinished calls for the previous query ( Arora et al., 2026 ) .
In Speculative Interaction Agents (SIA), incoming user or tool updates interrupt ongoing generation, potentially before a complete tool call is produced, while dispatched tools are managed separately ( Hooper et al., 2026 ) .
Outside speech, PASTE predicts upcoming calls from recurring execution patterns and starts them while the LLM is still generating ( Sui et al., 2026 ) .
Heartbeat allows successive Thinker invocations to overlap within a concurrency limit.
This supports denser triggers without making the next input update a deadline for ongoing generation.
blocks.zh:
在在线语义解析中通过前缀对程序预测和选择性子程序执行研究了早期工具执行(周等,2022年).
随后的系统在作为输入变化的计算方式上有所不同.
SHANKS将语音与推理和工具调用进行交互调用,但其每堆生成预算可留下长调参数不完整(Chiang等人,2026年,附录C.2).
Stream RAG将固定间距平行检索与模式触发的查询对比起来,这些查询终止了先前查询未完成的呼叫(Arora等人,2026年).
在Speculative Interacties(SIA)中,进入的用户或工具更新可能会在生成完整的工具调用之前中断正在进行的生成,而发送的工具则单独管理(Hooper等人,2026年)。
PASTE预测在LLM仍在生成时,
Heartbeat允许连续的智者引用在货币限度内重叠.
这支持更密集的触发器,而不使下一次输入更新持续生成的最后期限.

blocks.en:
Decoupled systems use different interfaces to pass intermediate work between components.
The SHANKS + call-after-listen configuration passes successful calls and their results to a model that processes the complete request ( Chiang et al., 2026 ) .
DuplexOmni separates real-time interaction from background reasoning and tool use, returning intermediate outputs through a streaming interface ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
Other interfaces operate within the model’s generation process: AsyncLM encodes tool calls and returned results in the token stream ( Gim et al., 2024 ) , whereas AsyncReasoning coordinates thinker and writer views through shared model-internal attention state ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ) .
Heartbeat connects independent Thinker invocations, asynchronous tool jobs, and an endpoint-triggered Responder through completed reasoning records and tool results.
This external interface permits independent model selection and module-level optimization without requiring shared model-internal state.
blocks.zh:
脱钩系统使用不同的接口通过组件之间的中间工作.
SHANKS + call-after- listen配置将成功的呼叫及其结果传递给一个处理完整请求的模型(Chiang et al., 2026).
DuplexOmni将实时互动与背景推理和工具使用区分开来,通过流线接口返回中间输出(Huang等人,2026) .
其他接口在模型生成过程中运行: 自动同步 LM 编码工具在符号流中调用并返回结果(Gim等人,2024年),而AsyncReasoning则通过共享模型-内部关注状态来协调思想家和作家的观点(Yakushev等人,2025年).
心动连接独立 思考者引用,一个同步的工具任务,以及通过完成的推理记录和工具结果,一个端点触发的Responder.
这种外部接口允许独立的模型选择和模块级优化,而不需要共享模型-内部状态.
